Introduction.text: ......if you have an interest in archaeology local history, churches, historic buildings heraldry, history or any other topic concerned with Leicestershire's past.

- receive a copy of the annual journal - receive a copy of the Leicestershire Historian - take part in occasional excursions - receive the Newsletter Two members from the same household can join for 20 but only receive one copy of the Society's publications If you would like to join the Society, or require further details, please contact the Honorary Membership Secretary, Mr Geoff Clark-Monks, The Guildhall, Leicester, LE1 5FQ Now on the internet http://www.le.ac.uk/lahs/
